section5.h2: One price, and nothing added later
section5.text: Invisalign is commonly quoted between $5,500 and $7,500. New patients at Legacy Dental Pasadena pay $3,379 for the whole course of treatment, after a $600 new-patient coupon. That figure is not a starting point or a deposit: it is what the treatment costs, from the first scan to the retainers you leave with.
section5.fine-print: New patients only, limited-time promotional pricing. A $100 deposit reserves the price and is fully refundable, credited to your first appointment. Payment plans are available, including a 0% option over 24 months. Credit cards carry a 3% surcharge; debit, HSA and FSA do not. Where you have orthodontic cover, we file on your behalf and reimbursement typically runs $1,000 to $3,000, paid to you.

section-navy6.h2: Because almost none of it is sent out
section-navy6.text: The scanning, the imaging, the treatment planning and the printing all happen in the building. There is no outside lab in the middle of your case, no waiting on a courier, and no third party adding a margin to every stage. That is most of the difference between $3,379 and the figure quoted down the road.
section7.benefit-text: A series of clear, removable aligners rather than brackets and wires. Most people will not notice you are wearing them.
section7.benefit-text2: You take the aligners out for meals and to brush and floss, so nothing changes about how you eat or how you clean your teeth.
section7.benefit-text3: The movement is planned digitally from the start, so treatment needs fewer visits than traditional orthodontics.
section7.benefit-text4: Most cases finish inside that window, and many patients notice a change in the first few weeks.

section9.h2: Four steps, and you can stop after the first
section9.journey-text: An exam and a conversation about what you want changed. Dr. Sunyoto tells you whether Invisalign is the right answer for your case, and says so if it is not.
section9.journey-text2: An iTero scan builds a 3D model of your teeth, with no putty impressions. You see a preview of the finished result before you commit to anything.
section9.journey-text3: A $100 deposit locks the promotional pricing while your aligners are made. It is fully refundable and it comes off your first appointment.
section9.journey-text4: Your aligner series arrives and you change trays on schedule. Most courses run 6 to 18 months, and you leave with a set of retainers.

section13.h2: The things people ask before they book
section13.text: If yours is not here, the consultation is free and there is no obligation attached to it. You can also just call and ask.

faq.a: Invisalign is a series of clear, removable aligners that straighten your teeth without metal braces. They are comfortable, nearly invisible, and allow you to eat, brush and floss normally during treatment.

faq.q: How long does Invisalign treatment take?
faq.a: Most Invisalign treatments take 6 to 18 months, depending on your case. Many patients start seeing noticeable improvements within the first few weeks.

Everything you need from start to finish: a comprehensive exam and 3D digital scan, your custom Invisalign aligners, a personalised treatment plan, all office visits and adjustments, and one set of retainers. No hidden fees.
Yes. Alongside paying in full, there is an in-office plan starting with $1,000 down, and a 0% interest option of about $166 a month over 24 months. You can start treatment with a low down payment.
Yes, retainers come standard with every treatment. They are essential for keeping your teeth in their new position, so we make sure you are set up for lasting results.

faq.q: Do I need to come in often?
faq.a: No. Because the movement is planned digitally, you will have fewer visits than with traditional orthodontics.

cta14.h2: Find out what your smile would look like
cta14.text: The consultation is free, it includes the 3D scan, and it ends with you seeing the result before you have spent anything. If it is not right for you, we will tell you that too.
